notes.title: MASSIVE Update 1.1 Now Live! - New Content And Features/Fixes!
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25869624/9680c4ecbc6aba72ae746ef07bac433f0e4912e0.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25869624/fe6897c6cc7fabbe5b0c5a7348b42132c1812b3e.png[/img][/url]

Content:

-New level has been added to campaign.  Play the role of a special agent, with one objective.  Kill the fuhrer!  Experience and explore the large open environment in the beautiful Alps of Berchtesgaden, Germany.  Infiltrate the Eagles Nest and take out the target!  Be careful not to get noticed, or your job becomes much more difficult!

-New game mode called, 'The Hunted'.  Battle 1v1 with AI snipers which spawn in a random locations.  Each sniper you kill, a new and much more difficult sniper is sent to hunt you down!

-New weapons.  Use the pump action shotgun in Rush mode and campaign level The Last Stand(Oh man is it ever satisfying!).  Use the silenced .45 Pistol in the new Eagles Nest level.

-Nazi soldier textures have been given a make over.  Uniforms are more accurate looking to a WW2 era German soldier.



Changes/Fixes:

-Omaha Beach has been nerfed!  AI are less accurate and machine guns spray has been slightly decreased.

-Many tweaks and changes made to AI.  Pathfinding is now fully dynamic with the ability to correctly navigate to moving targets.  Many other small behavioral changes were made.

-Accuracy bug in stats has been fixed.  Problem occurred because headshots were tracked as 2 hits(Sorry guys, turns out your accuracy wasn't 125%) 

-Full body collision added to player in Paris level.  Player was missing body collision and could only be hit in the head from enemy fire.  The levels difficulty is now slightly harder now that your body can be hit.

-AI in level The Last Stand(Rush mode), now navigate to both sides of the players barricade, making it much more difficult for the player to camp the floor.


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25869624/9680c4ecbc6aba72ae746ef07bac433f0e4912e0.png[/img]

notes.title: Update - Improvements To Scope/Aiming And More!
notes.content:
- Scope & view size have been increased significantly for easier viewing.

- Scope FOV has been increased slightly.

- Aim smoothing further increased for more steady aiming.

- AI reaction time bug fixed.  When AI were in patrolling state the reaction time 
was instantaneous when alerted to player.

- Room center changed for Paris level.  Previous position hung off the edge of building too far.

notes.title: Free Demo Released & Small Update!
notes.content:
Free demo is now available.  Play as a rogue sniper in the streets of Paris during the surrender of France and get a short experience of what it feels like to be The Last Sniper!

A Small update was added to both the demo and full game as well.
-Rocks now take less force to kill enemy when thrown.
-Bug fixed where mission would not complete on the small chance an AI gets stuck.

notes.title: First Update Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello, the first update is now live.  I have been listening carefully to everyone. I worked hard to make a quick update prioritizing the most requested fixes that were possible to make in good time.

- AI have been improved.  Enemies will now duck and cover behind obstacles.  Enemies also now play hit animations and react to getting shot.  A few other small behavior changes and fixes were made to AI.

- Hit box detection bug has been fixed.  The issues in hit detection were caused by floating collision left over from dead enemy heads which would block bullets(ROFL!).

- Head shots now make a more loud distinct pop sound, letting the player know he has a confirmed head shot.  Head hit box size has also been increased a slight bit.

- Small changes have been made to some of the levels.  With AI having duck and cover, some extra obstacles were added, and a few layouts changed.

-Some bugs in player stats were fixed.  Specifically accuracy and shots fired in the first mission.

- Weapon aim smoothing slightly increased.

There's your first update everyone!  Enjoy!
